svg.title: Moving Off Fully Insured Without Getting Burned
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-funding-switch-process; chapter number: 1; chart type: process_flow; title: Moving Off Fully Insured Without Getting Burned; subtitle: Five practitioner steps from renewal math to a self-funded future; caption: Practitioners sequence the funding switch around loss-ratio math, written surplus terms, complete IMQ paperwork, a modeled year-two downside, and a claims-experience harvest that opens traditional self-funding.; assumptions note: Step order is an editorial sequence of separate practitioner tips and gates. Every figure is an attributed practitioner claim and varies by contract and carrier.; note: Sources are Dr. Eric Bricker (AHealthcareZ - Healthcare Finance Explained), Tyler Dutchover, Warp, and Maximize Asset Protection.; stages: step: 01; label: Run Loss-Ratio Math on Renewal; value: Step 1; detail: A 120-employee Dallas group at a 60% loss ratio got a flat renewal and no refund, leaving roughly $560,000 of about $1.4 million in premium with the carrier (Dr. Eric Bricker).; step: 02; label: Lock Surplus Split in Writing; value: Step 2; detail: Level-funded contracts return 50% to 80% of the leftover claims fund as cash or lower rates, depending on the specific contract (Tyler Dutchover).; step: 03; label: Collect Every IMQ; value: Step 3; detail: Some carriers require an Individual Medical Questionnaire taking three to five minutes per employee. Warp says typical brokers skip level funding over the extra work, while Warp has produced quotes showing 60% plus savings.; step: 04; label: Model the Year-Two Laser; value: Step 4; detail: Price a renewal laser that pushes one employee's specific attachment to $200,000, plus the 10 percent or higher fully insured fallback rate (Tyler Dutchover).; step: 05; label: Harvest Claims Experience for Self-Funding; value: Step 5; detail: Allstate will look at traditional self-funding for groups under 100 lives that arrive with level-funded claims proof, provided the business can write a check for the full aggregate within a couple of months (Maximize Asset Protection).
